title: Push Pull Legs, minimalist
author: noahmjohnson
desc: Get strength and size without sacrificing hours at the gym. You can do these routines all in the same week but it is ok for those who can only go when they have the time to just do the next routine in the program.

ex.note: Warm up before first set, heavy set aim for 1-3 reps. Final two sets are back off sets keep this between 3-6 reps.
Last set is a drop set, got to failure then half the initial weight and go to failure again and half it again.
